text: 你爬上岸，身体因高空跳水造成的剧痛而疼痛不已。你花了很久才喘匀气。你的俘虏肯定以为那次可怕的跳跃已经要了你的命。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 397
text: You crawl up on the beach, your body aching from the punishing high dive. It takes you a long time to catch your breath. Surely your captors must think you have been killed by the terrifying leap.
